summary: Iter 177 — mobile re-test of the two iter176 P1 bugs on the rebuilt AI tools (Classification Self-Check, Budget & Lifetime Cap Calculator, Statement Decoder). BOTH P1 BUGS ARE RESOLVED. (1) CSC result panel now reads the real /api/public/csc/run (csc.payload.v1) shape correctly: confidence pill (csc-confidence-medium 'Medium confidence'), csc-result-header shows 'INDICATIVE BAND' + 'Classification 5 to 7', annual $39,697 to $58,148, quarterly $8,932 to $13,083, profile_summary text rendered ('Substantial daily-care needs...'), csc-drivers card populated with 3 named driver blocks (domain label + answer, e.g. 'Cognition and behaviour / Significant', 'Mood / Significant', 'Cognition and behaviour / Often') — no empty bullets, plus a Gap-detected badge, csc-next-step-a with the 'Draft a reassessment letter' CTA, csc-rerun button, and 'Payload version csc.payload.v1' footer. (2) Primary CTA label + icon now render WHITE (rgb(255,255,255)) on both the light-mode teal fill (rgb(14,77,82)) and the dark-mode terracotta fill (rgb(165,81,43)) for all three tool buttons (csc-submit, bc-submit, decoder-submit). Regression checks: Budget Calculator end-to-end works (Class 4 → annual $29,696, quarterly $6,681.60, care mgmt $742.40, per-stream allocations, rollover floor $1,000.00). Statement Decoder text-paste flow works end-to-end (SMART SUMMARY generated with 8 anomalies flagged, statement period 01/07/2025-30/09/2025). Both prior P1s resolved; no new bugs observed on the 3 rebuilt tools.
action_items: None for the two iter176 P1s — verified resolved. Proceed to rebuild the remaining 6 tools (provider-price-checker, contribution-estimator, care-plan-reviewer, letters-and-follow-ups, invoice-checker, family-coordinator) which are still on the older FormTool path.
critical_code_review_comments: Recommend adding a small snapshot / contrast unit test on the shared Button component to lock in the white-label-on-primary invariant so this class of regression doesn't recur (this is now the 3rd iteration where a CTA contrast bug slipped in and was fixed).

Consider extending the DOMAIN_LABEL map in /app/mobile/src/components/tools/ClassificationSelfCheck.tsx to also cover the domain strings the backend currently returns capitalised ('Cognition and behaviour', 'Mood', 'Safety', 'Home environment', 'Informal support') — right now the map keys are lowercase snake_case and the fallback returns the raw domain, which happens to look fine because the backend already returns human-readable labels, but the two shapes should be aligned to avoid future drift.

rca of the issue: Both P1 fixes verified at source and at runtime. (1) /app/mobile/src/components/tools/ClassificationSelfCheck.tsx was fully rewritten to consume classification.primary / range_low / range_high / confidence / annual_budget_low|high / quarterly_budget_low|high, result.profile_summary, and top_drivers[{question_id, domain, answer}] — matches csc.payload.v1 exactly, and the runtime render shows populated header, summary, and driver blocks. (2) /app/mobile/src/components/ui.tsx Button component sets palette.primary.fg = '#fff' and explicitly passes that colour into both the icon (<Icon color={p.fg}>) and the label (<Text style={{color: p.fg}}>), so the label no longer inherits the theme default text colour. Verified in-browser: label computed color is rgb(255,255,255) on both light-mode teal rgb(14,77,82) and dark-mode terracotta rgb(165,81,43) across csc-submit, bc-submit, and decoder-submit.
